title: Broken Letters, Broken Narratives: A Case Study on Arabic Script in DALL-E 3
benchmark_measurement: Stereotypical association of Arabic script with antiquity and religious motifs, particularly Islamic ones like mosque backgrounds, in a text-to-image AI model.
findings: The DALL-E 3 model exhibits a significant bias by frequently associating Arabic script with religious motifs, such as mosque backgrounds, even when not prompted. This is identified as an extension of Orientalist stereotypes that frame the culture as ancient and religious, reducing the multifaceted art form to a visually exotic abstraction.
